decisions.statement: The catalog is read out of the game's own scene source rather than hand-written.
One record is taken for each distinct component the scene source names.
The records are divided into three modules by how the game hides the part.
A call naming no checkout writes into what `CODE_ROOT` names, else this repository.
A run parses by the rules sitting beside that run rather than by the tree's.
A scene source naming no component refuses the call.
A rendered module over the akasha ceiling refuses the call and nothing is written.
The checkout written into is named on the call.
The catalog lands as one mechanical change rather than written by this command.
A module the checkout already has is left out of that change.
The three modules are written into the folder the hud components already sit in.
That folder is spelled here rather than read off a page sitting in it.
A move of that folder is respelled here by hand, because nothing imports it.
A rendered module names what it imports from the root rather than by a relative path.
A component the game creates at runtime is outside this catalog.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.
A test seam is taken after the world, so a real call reaches the work.
An argument this command does not take is refused rather than passed over.

definition: the command writing the catalog of HUD parts out of the game's own scene source
